# pineconebyoc_environment (Resource)

The `pineconebyoc_environment` resource registers a BYOC environment with Pinecone and mints the credentials it runs on. Changing any argument forces a new resource.

It mints a Pinecone API key (`cpgw_api_key`), a service account, the `__SLI__` project and its key, and a Datadog API key. Create it before any cloud resource: `environment_name` names them. Learn more about BYOC in the [docs](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/production/bring-your-own-cloud).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pineconebyoc_environment" "this" {
  cloud  = "aws"
  region = "us-east-1"

  # Defaults, shown for reference.
  is_public_endpoint_enabled = true

  # Set only to serve the environment under your own domain.
  # domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider: `aws`, `gcp` or `azure`.
- `region` (String) Cloud region of the environment.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Domain the environment is served under. Null for pinecone.io.
- `is_public_endpoint_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the environment serves a public endpoint. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) The provider's `api_url` when the environment was created.
- `cpgw_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key the environment calls Pinecone with. It also authorizes `pineconebyoc_dns_delegation` and `pineconebyoc_amp_access`.
- `cpgw_api_key_id` (String) ID of `cpgw_api_key`.
- `datadog_api_key` (String, Sensitive) The environment's Datadog key.
- `datadog_key_id` (String) ID of the environment's Datadog key.
- `environment_fqdn` (String) `<environment_name>.<domain>`.
- `environment_name` (String) Environment name, such as `aws-us-east-1-ab12.byoc`. Cloud resource names derive from it.
- `gcp_project` (String) Pinecone's GCP project the environment reports to.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the API key belongs to.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name at creation. A later rename doesn't reach the environment.
- `service_account_client_id` (String) Client ID of the environment's service account.
- `service_account_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the environment's service account.
- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the environment's service account.
- `sli_api_key` (String, Sensitive) ProjectEditor API key of the `__SLI__` project, for the environment's availability checks.
- `sli_api_key_id` (String) ID of `sli_api_key`.
- `sli_project_id` (String) ID of the environment's `__SLI__` project.
- `subdomain` (String) `environment_name` without `.byoc`. The input of `pineconebyoc_dns_delegation`.
